markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (79%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
Normal remains in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 79%, Normal 12% | InSitu clear leader |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu | Two classes inseparable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96; OOD 1.0 | Not flagged [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Agrees | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu | Unanimous neighbors [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tubule formation** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Glandular architecture; lower invasive association [F4] · Weak
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 2, 3, 7) · context · Above typical density; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Largest positive concept term · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 8) · ↓ invasive · Two-layered epithelium; lower invasive association [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deleting top 3 regions lowers invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect vs random includes 0 (CI −0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Necrosis and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The true class is Normal (12%), which stays in the conformal set.
- Reliability score ranks errors only moderately (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87); input is a simulated composite.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 5, 9:** Confirm gland architecture; separate benign glands from in situ involvement.
2. **7, 10, 11:** Verify true necrosis; region 11 carries the highest region-level invasive risk (50%).
3. **3, 7, 11:** Lateral margin strip; suggested call is tumor at margin, simulated frozen section [F7].
